evals.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post about how I use Claude Code to build AI tools 10x faster than hiring developers.
evals.expected_output: A LinkedIn post with a strong results/numbers hook, short punchy paragraphs, arrow lists, and a CTA with a keyword. Should read in the user's own brand voice — confident, first-person, specific numbers.

assertions.name: hook_contains_number
assertions.description: The first line of the post contains a specific number, dollar amount, percentage, or timeframe

assertions.name: hook_is_short
assertions.description: The hook (first 1-2 lines) is concise — not more than 15 words

assertions.name: uses_arrow_formatting
assertions.description: The post uses → or 𐄂 for bullet/list items rather than plain dashes or dots

assertions.name: has_keyword_cta
assertions.description: The post contains a 'Comment [KEYWORD]' call to action with a specific word in quotes or caps

assertions.name: short_paragraphs
assertions.description: All paragraphs are 3 sentences or fewer — no walls of text

assertions.name: first_person_voice
assertions.description: The post is written in first person (I, my, I've, I did) rather than second person (you should, here's how you)

assertions.name: no_corporate_jargon
assertions.description: The post avoids phrases like 'leverage', 'actionable insights', 'game-changer', 'synergies', 'thought leader'
